From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@acmehealth.com>; Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Activation plan & stakeholder sync — proposed MAP orientation

Hi Elena / Samir —

Thanks again for the time earlier this week. As discussed, I put together a short mutual action plan (attached) and a draft agenda for an orientation/kickoff so we can align stakeholders, confirm the evaluation plan, and lock in a timeline toward close.

Proposed slot (please confirm):
- Wednesday, May 27 — 10:00–11:00 AM PT (we can shift if that doesn't work)

Zoom (placeholder): https://zoom.us/j/0000000000 (will send final link with calendar invite)
Calendar hold (editable): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-proposed-hold

Draft agenda (high level):
1) Introductions & roles (10 min) — who owns QA/eval, infra, security sign-off
2) Walk through MAP milestones & owner responsibilities (20 min)
3) Evaluation plan & success criteria (15 min)
4) Operational next steps: data access, test accounts, logs (10 min)
5) Q&A & scheduling follow-ups (5 min)

Attachments: MAP_Draft_v1.pdf, MAP_Agenda_draft.md
Related Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAPdocs
HubSpot deal: RDW-2045-Acme (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/2045)

Ask: Can you confirm the best attendees from Acme, and whether May 27th 10a PT works? If not, please suggest two alternatives.

Thanks — look forward to getting this rolling.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142
